highlight_subsections.heading: EAGLE Speculative Decoding Improvements
highlight_subsections.summary: **EAGLE Speculative Decoding Improvements**: Multi-step CUDA graph support (#29559), DP>1 support (#26086), and multimodal support with Qwen3VL (#29594).

highlight_subsections.heading: Significant Performance Optimizations
highlight_subsections.summary: **Significant Performance Optimizations**: 18.1% throughput improvement from batch invariant BMM (#29345), 2.2% throughput improvement from shared experts overlap (#28879).

highlight_subsections.heading: AMD ROCm Expansion
highlight_subsections.summary: **AMD ROCm Expansion**: DeepSeek v3.2 + SparseMLA support (#26670), FP8 MLA decode (#28032), AITER attention backend (#28701).
